description: Get a download link for a completed envelope's sealed evidence bundle: a ZIP holding the final signed PDF, the signer records and the hash-chained audit trail, with a manifest signed by SignaTrust's published key (listed at https://www.signatrust.io/trust/keys). Returns url, expiresAt, sha256 (of the ZIP bytes), sizeBytes and signingKeyFingerprint. The link works ONCE and expires after 15 minutes: fetch it with a plain HTTP GET (no auth header) straight to a file, and do not pass the ZIP's bytes through the conversation. Check the file's SHA-256 against sha256, then verify it at https://www.signatrust.io/verify. Refused with HTTP 409 and a code: ENVELOPE_NOT_COMPLETED; BLIND_CUSTODY (SignaTrust's servers cannot open a blind-custody document, so the bundle is assembled in the SignaTrust web app); DOCUMENT_DESTROYED (the signed document was destroyed after delivery; use get_evidence and verify_blockchain instead). Requires the envelopes:read scope on your API key.
name: get_evidence_bundle
